ache.title: Sakimoto music, Tactics vibes, gacha underneath
ache.note: Nero tries Sword of Convallaria, a tactics game inspired by Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics, with music by Hitoshi Sakimoto. That’s the trap: a genre you love and a composer you trust, with a gacha system tucked inside. He asks if it’s ‘worth your time’. Good question. Keep asking it after week one.
watch: a beloved genre with gacha underneath
great art and music as the hook
ache.tip: If you love tactics games, try one without gacha too. Then compare how each one treats your evenings.
lines: Sakimoto music is a cheat code for hearts
worth your time? ask again in a month

title: First Impressions | Sword of Convallaria
excerpt: Join me as I dive into the newly released Sword of Convallaria, a tactical RPG inspired by Fire Emblem and Final Fantasy Tactics. I discuss my first impressions, gameplay mechanics, character designs, gacha systems, and the stunning music by Hitoshi Sakimoto. Find out what stood out, what fell flat, and whether this game is worth your time. Let me know your thoughts in the comments!
